# Verizon
> Verizon provides wireless, internet, TV, phone, and business connectivity services, plus devices, plans, support, and account management.

Verizon serves consumers, small businesses, and enterprises with mobile service, home internet, Fios, streaming and TV options, device sales, trade-in programs, and network coverage tools. The site also includes support resources, account access, accessibility information, and dedicated business solutions.

## Main
- [Verizon Home](https://www.verizon.com/): Official Verizon homepage for wireless, internet, TV, phone, and device offers.
- [Shop](https://www.verizon.com/shop/): Central shopping hub for phones, tablets, watches, accessories, and connected devices.
- [Deals](https://www.verizon.com/deals/): Current promotions on devices, plans, home internet, and bundle offers.
- [Coverage Map](https://www.verizon.com/coverage-map/): Interactive map for wireless coverage, 5G availability, and home internet eligibility.
- [Why Verizon](https://www.verizon.com/why-verizon/): Overview of Verizon network strengths, plan benefits, and service advantages.

## Wireless Plans
- [Unlimited Plans](https://www.verizon.com/plans/unlimited/): Compare Verizon unlimited phone plans, pricing, perks, and plan features.
- [Prepaid Plans](https://www.verizon.com/plans/prepaid/): Explore prepaid wireless plans with talk, text, and data options.
- [Bring Your Own Device](https://www.verizon.com/bring-your-own-device/): Activate an existing compatible phone or device on Verizon service.
- [International Plans](https://www.verizon.com/plans/international/international-travel/): Travel and international usage options for calling, texting, and data abroad.
- [Family Plans](https://www.verizon.com/plans/): Browse mobile plan options for individuals, families, and multiple lines.

## Phones and Devices
- [Smartphones](https://www.verizon.com/smartphones/): Shop smartphones from Apple, Samsung, Google, and other major brands.
- [Apple iPhone](https://www.verizon.com/smartphones/apple/): Browse available iPhone models, pricing, colors, and upgrade options.
- [Samsung Phones](https://www.verizon.com/smartphones/samsung/): Shop Samsung Galaxy phones with Verizon plans and financing options.
- [Google Phones](https://www.verizon.com/smartphones/google/): Explore Google Pixel phones, specs, and Verizon purchase options.
- [Tablets](https://www.verizon.com/tablets/): Shop tablets for work, entertainment, and connected mobile use.
- [Smartwatches](https://www.verizon.com/smartwatches/): Browse connected smartwatches and wearable devices for Verizon plans.
- [Accessories](https://www.verizon.com/products/accessories/): Shop cases, chargers, audio gear, and device accessories.

## Home Internet and TV
- [Home Internet](https://www.verizon.com/home/internet/): Compare Verizon home internet options including Fios and wireless home internet.
- [Fios Internet](https://www.verizon.com/home/fios/): Learn about Verizon Fios internet plans, speeds, and availability.
- [5G Home Internet](https://www.verizon.com/home/internet/5g/): Explore Verizon 5G Home Internet service, plans, and availability.
- [LTE Home Internet](https://www.verizon.com/home/internet/lte/): Review LTE Home Internet service for eligible areas.
- [Fios TV](https://www.verizon.com/home/fios-tv/): Discover Fios TV packages, channel options, and entertainment features.
- [Home Phone](https://www.verizon.com/home/phone/): View home phone service options for Verizon residential customers.

## Account and Billing
- [My Verizon](https://www.verizon.com/my-verizon/): Access account management, billing, usage, upgrades, and service settings.
- [Sign In](https://secure.verizon.com/signin): Sign in to Verizon accounts for billing, support, and device management.
- [Pay Bill](https://www.verizon.com/digital/nsa/nos/ui/payment/otp/login#/): Make a Verizon payment or manage billing online.
- [Register Account](https://secure.verizon.com/account/register/start): Create online access for managing Verizon services and account details.
- [Verizon App](https://www.verizon.com/solutions-and-services/apps/verizon-app/): Learn about the Verizon app for account, billing, and service management.

## Support
- [Support Home](https://www.verizon.com/support/): Main support hub for troubleshooting, billing, devices, and service questions.
- [Mobile Support](https://www.verizon.com/support/mobile/): Help resources for wireless devices, plans, activation, and account issues.
- [Internet Support](https://www.verizon.com/support/residential/internet/): Support for Verizon home internet, setup, troubleshooting, and service issues.
- [Fios TV Support](https://www.verizon.com/support/residential/tv/): Help for Fios TV setup, remotes, channels, and troubleshooting.
- [Order Status](https://www.verizon.com/od/cust/orderStatusIndex#/): Track Verizon device, accessory, and service orders online.
- [Device Trade-In](https://www.verizon.com/trade-in/): Start or manage device trade-in offers and value estimates.

## Network and Service Tools
- [Network Status Checker](https://www.verizon.com/support/check-network-status/): Check for outages and service issues affecting Verizon wireless or home services.
- [Bring Your Own Device Compatibility](https://www.verizon.com/bring-your-own-device/): Verify whether an existing device can be activated on Verizon.
- [5G Overview](https://www.verizon.com/5g/): Learn about Verizon 5G, coverage types, and supported experiences.
- [International Services Support](https://www.verizon.com/support/international-services/): Support information for travel, roaming, and international calling services.
- [Device Protection](https://www.verizon.com/solutions-and-services/add-ons/protection-and-security/): Explore protection, insurance, and security add-ons for Verizon devices.

## Business
- [Verizon Business](https://www.verizon.com/business/): Business hub for wireless, internet, networking, and communications solutions.
- [Business Wireless](https://www.verizon.com/business/products/mobile/): Mobile plans, devices, and connectivity solutions for business customers.
- [Business Internet](https://www.verizon.com/business/products/internet-services/): Business internet offerings including broadband, wireless, and dedicated connectivity.
- [Network Solutions](https://www.verizon.com/business/products/networking/): Enterprise networking, SD WAN, security, and managed network services.
- [Voice and Collaboration](https://www.verizon.com/business/products/voice-collaboration/): Business phone, unified communications, and collaboration solutions.
- [IoT](https://www.verizon.com/business/products/internet-of-things/): Internet of Things platforms, connectivity, and industry-specific solutions.
- [Small Business](https://www.verizon.com/business/small-business/): Solutions tailored for small businesses, including internet, phones, and support.

## Accessibility and Legal
- [Accessibility](https://www.verizon.com/accessibility/): Accessibility resources, assistive services, and inclusive product information.
- [Accessibility Support](https://www.verizon.com/support/accessibility/): Customer support resources for accessibility-related service and device needs.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.verizon.com/about/privacy/): Verizon privacy practices, data handling, and consumer privacy information.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://www.verizon.com/support/customer-agreement/): Customer agreement and service terms for Verizon products and plans.
- [About Verizon](https://www.verizon.com/about/): Corporate information, company news, leadership, and investor-related resources.

## News and Resources
- [Verizon News](https://www.verizon.com/about/news/): Company announcements, product news, network updates, and corporate stories.
- [About Verizon](https://www.verizon.com/about/): Corporate overview including leadership, responsibility, and company initiatives.
- [Investor Relations](https://www.verizon.com/about/investors/): Financial reports, earnings information, and investor resources.
- [Careers](https://www.verizon.com/about/work/): Explore jobs, hiring information, and career opportunities at Verizon.
